mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 11 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 11, low 8.

US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has removed senior Pentagon strategist Brett Sylvia from his position at the Joint Staff.

Kosovo's Police Inspectorate has suspended 11 officers over their handling of the murder case of Arlinda Zekaj, who was killed on Oct. 25, 2025, in Vitomiricë, Peja.

Prime Minister Albin Kurti met NATO's Supreme Allied Commander Europe, General Alexus Grynke, and said Kosovo will complete its ten-year security force plan before 2028.

Arab parties in Israel have called on the opposition to form an alliance aimed at toppling Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and establishing a new government.

Grasshoppers forward Samuel Krasniqi, 19, says he has not yet decided whether to represent Kosovo, Albania or Switzerland at the international level.
